title: Malbrough
identity: François Combelle’s *Malbrough: Thème et Variation* is a 1938 published work for E-flat alto saxophone and piano (Andrieu Frères). The current catalog’s discography lead reports that Marcel Mule recorded Combelle’s *Variations sur Malborough* with pianist Marcel Gaveau; alternate spellings appear across records.

evidence.claim: National Institute of Informatics/CiNii author catalog records *Malbrough: Thème et Variation* for alto saxophone and piano, published by Andrieu Frères in 1938.
UCSB discography record attributes a recording titled *Variations sur Malborough* to Marcel Mule, saxophone, Marcel Gaveau, piano, and François Combelle, arranger.
